dimensions.note: Maximum bare-cell dimensions from one lithium iron phosphate cell specification; lithium-ion 14500 cells are listed at 14 by 50 mm nominal. Unprotected cell. Protected cells (with a circuit board) and button-top cells are longer than the bare flat-top cell, commonly by 2 to 5 mm; check the maker's listed length before relying on a fit.

geometry.note: Button-top versions exist. Cells with an integrated protection board are slightly longer.

variants.label: Oriental Willing IFR14500 600mAh

capacity_mah.conditions: Typical 600 mAh, minimum 580 mAh, 0.5C discharge to 2.0 V

variants.notes: Weight is 17 g plus or minus 2 g; max continuous is 1C and 10-second pulse is 3C; internal resistance is the maximum at 1 kHz; cycle life is "over 2000" cycles at 0.5C and 100% depth.

interchange.note: The ER14505 is a non-rechargeable lithium thionyl chloride battery in the same size; it must not be charged, and a 14500 lithium-ion battery has a different voltage window.

safety: Charge only with a charger made for lithium-ion batteries, using constant current then constant voltage (CC/CV) up to the charge voltage in the battery datasheet (4.2 V for cobalt, nickel and manganese chemistries, 3.65 V for lithium iron phosphate).
Do not discharge below the datasheet cutoff voltage (2.5 V for most batteries listed here); deep discharge damages the battery and a damaged battery should be discarded.
The metal can is the negative terminal. A torn or missing wrap exposes the can and can short the battery against a metal object or an adjacent battery.

Unprotected batteries have no overcharge, over-discharge or short-circuit protection of their own and need protection in the charger or the device; protected batteries carry a circuit board but should still be charged with a matching charger.

Transport limits apply: the U.S. FAA requires spare lithium-ion batteries to travel in carry-on baggage with the terminals protected against short circuit, and limits rechargeable lithium-ion batteries to 100 Wh each (FAA PackSafe).
notes: Size code: 14 mm diameter, 50 mm length, 0 for cylindrical. Same size as an AA cell; device compartments and chargers for AA cells do not make a 14500 safe to use.
